entries.explanation: 776 qabl-e-Maseeh se qadeem Olympics ke mehfooz fatah ke records shuru hote hain. Koroibos of Elis stadion race ke pehle darj shuda champion thay; yeh tareekh riwayati record ki ibtida hai.
330 qabl-e-Maseeh mein Alexander ki fauj ne Persepolis par qabza kiya aur shehar loota aur jalaya gaya. Yeh Achaemenid Farsi badshahon ka aham rasmi markaz tha.
44 qabl-e-Maseeh mein Julius Caesar ko dictator perpetuo, yani ta-hayat dictator, banaya gaya. Woh qadeem Rome ki siyasi aur fauji shakhsiyat thay; Rome maujooda Italy mein hai.
1026 mein Mahmud Ghaznavi ne Somnath mandir par hamla kiya. Yeh mandir Gujarat ke Gir Somnath ilaqay mein Arabian Sea ke sahil ke qareeb hai, is liye hamlay ko Gujarat se jor kar samjhein.
Rumi ki paidaish 1207 mein Balkh se mansoob ki jati hai. Balkh us waqt aham ilmi aur saqafati markaz tha.
1210 mein Qutb-ud-Din Aibak ki wafat polo, yani chogan, ke hadsay se hui. Woh Delhi mein Mamluk ya Ghulam khandan ke iqtidar ke bani thay; hadsa un ki wafat ka sabab tha.

1215 mein King John aur baronon ke darmiyan Magna Carta Runnymede mein shahi mohar se manzoor hui. Runnymede darya-e-Thames ke kinare hai; pehle nuskhe ko mohar lagna, sirf dastakhat kehne se zyada durust hai.
1398 mein Amir Timur ne Hindustan par hamla karke Delhi par qabza kiya. Delhi ki loot maar isi hamlay ka aham waqia tha; hamlay ka saal aur mutasir shehar aik hi waqiay ke do pehlu hain.
1453 mein Sultan Mehmed II ne Constantinople fatah kiya, jis se Byzantine saltanat khatam hui. Isi kamyabi par unhein Fatih kaha gaya aur Usmani iqtidar ka naya daur shuru hua.

12 October 1492 ko Pinta ke mallah Rodrigo de Triana ne Columbus ke qaflay mein pehli zameen dekhi. Safar Spain ke Ferdinand aur Isabella ki sarparasti mein tha; zameen dekhna aur Columbus ka utarna alag waqiat hain.
Portugal ke Vasco da Gama May 1498 mein Calicut, aaj ke Kozhikode, pohnche. Europe se yeh samandari safar Africa ke Cape of Good Hope ka chakkar kaat kar Malabar Coast tak gaya.
21 April 1526 ko Babur ne Panipat mein Ibrahim Lodi ko shikast di. Is se Lodi hukumat khatam aur Mughal iqtidar ki bunyaad pari; Panipat ki doosri bari jangain 1556 aur 1761 mein huin.
1530 mein Babur ke baad un ke bete Humayun ne Mughal takht sambhala. Yani janashini Babur se unhi ke khandan mein Humayun ko mili.
1540 mein Sher Shah Suri ne Humayun ko shikast de kar Suri hukumat qaim ki. Humayun ki jila-watni ke is waqfay ke baad 1555 mein Mughal iqtidar wapas aaya, is liye Suri daur taqreeban 15 saal tha.
Akbar 15 October 1542 ko Umarkot mein paida hue, jab un ke walid Humayun jila-watni mein thay. Woh Humayun aur Hamida Banu Begum ke bete thay aur 1556 mein walid ke baad takht par baithe.
Humayun 1540 mein iqtidar se mehroom hue aur 1555 mein takht dobara hasil kiya. Donon saalon ke darmiyan taqreeban 15 saala jila-watni hai; 1555 un ki pehli takht-nashini nahin balkay wapsi thi.
Elizabeth I ka England aur Ireland par daur 1558 se 1603 tak raha. Woh Henry VIII ki beti aur Tudor khandan ki aakhri hukmaran thin; us daur ko maujooda United Kingdom ke naam se na milayein.
Akbar ne Chittor ka muhasra 1567 ke aakhir mein shuru kiya. Qila February 1568 mein Mughal qabzay mein aaya, is liye muhasray ke aghaz aur fatah ke saal alag hain.
February 1568 mein Akbar ne Chittorgarh ka qila fatah kiya. Yeh us muhasray ka natija tha jo 1567 ke aakhir mein shuru hua tha; 1567 aghaz aur 1568 fatah ka saal hai.

31 December 1600 ko Elizabeth I ne East India Company ko shahi charter diya. Is ka bunyadi maqsad mashriqi ilaqon se tijarat ki ijazat aur tijarati ijara tha, na ke isi din Hindustan ki hukumat sambhalna.
1612 ki Swally jang mein Captain Thomas Best ne Portuguese fleet ke khilaf kamyabi hasil ki. Is behri kamyabi se East India Company ka Surat mein tijarati maqam mazboot hua.
1613 mein Company ne Mughal ijazat ke baad Surat mein mustaqil tijarati markaz banaya. Is se pehle Swally ki behri jang mein Portuguese fleet ke khilaf kamyabi ne yahan tijarat ko taqat di thi.
Shah Jahan ne Mumtaz Mahal ki yaad mein Taj Mahal banwane ka hukm diya aur tameer 1632 mein shuru hui. Yeh saal tameer ke aghaz ka hai, jabke markazi imarat baad ke barson mein mukammal hui.
1648 ke Westphalia aman muahidon ne Thirty Years' War khatam ki. Yeh muahiday Munster aur Osnabruck mein tay paye; is liye jang ke ikhtitam ko in do maqamat se bhi jora jata hai.
1707 mein Aurangzeb ki wafat ke baad janashini ki laraiyan aur soobai khudmukhtari barhi. Un ke bete Muazzam ne takht hasil karke Bahadur Shah I ka laqab liya; wafat Mughal zawaal ka aham mor bani.
Farsi badshah Nader Shah ne Mughal fauj ko shikast dene ke baad March 1739 mein Delhi par qabza kiya. Is waqiay mein hamla-awar Nader Shah aur nishana Mughal dar-ul-hukumat Delhi tha.
1748 mein Ahmad Shah Durrani ke pehle Hindustani hamlay ka muqabla Mughal fauj ne kiya. Punjab ke Manupur mein hone wali larai isi hamlay se mutalliq thi, na ke kisi baad ki Durrani muhim se.
Plassey ki jang 23 June 1757 ko Bengal mein lari gayi; Plassey jang ka maqam aur Bengal us ka ilaqai pas-e-manzar tha.
Jean-Jacques Rousseau ki The Social Contract 1762 mein shaya hui. Is siyasi falsafay ki kitab mein jaiz hukumat aur aam logon ke mushtarka iraday, yani general will, ka tasawwur bayan hua.
1765 ke Stamp Act mein akhbarat aur qanooni kagazat par tax ada hone ka sarkari stamp zaroori tha. Amreeki abadiyon ki is tax ke khilaf muzahamat se 'No taxation without representation' ka nara jura.
April 1775 mein Lexington aur Concord ki jharpon se Amreeki jang-e-azadi ka musallah aghaz hua. Jang 1783 ke Treaty of Paris par khatam hui, jab Britain ne Amreeki azadi tasleem ki.

Adam Smith ki Wealth of Nations ka pehla edition 1776 mein shaya hua. Is ka poora unwan An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations hai; chhota aur poora unwan aik hi kitab ke hain.

1776 ka Declaration of Independence Amreeki elan-e-azadi hai. Benjamin Franklin is ka maswada tayyar karne wali committee mein thay aur Amreeki inqilab ke rehnuma aur bani shakhsiyat mein shumar hote hain.
1775 mein shuru hone wali Amreeki jang-e-azadi 1783 ke Treaty of Paris par rasmi tor par khatam hui. Is muahiday mein Britain ne United States ki azadi tasleem ki.
Sir William Jones ne 1784 mein Calcutta mein Asiatic Society qaim ki. Is ilmi anjuman ka maqsad mashriqi uloom par tehqeeq tha; Calcutta ka maujooda naam Kolkata hai.

1784 mein William Pitt the Younger ki hukumat ka India Act British Parliament ne pass kiya. Is ne chhay sarkari numayindon wala Board of Control banaya jo Company ki siyasi aur intizami policy dekhta tha.

1787 mein Philadelphia ki Constitutional Convention ne Amreeki aain tayyar kiya aur 17 September ko dastakhat hue. Ijlas State House, aaj ke Independence Hall, mein hua; isi imarat ka azadi ke elan se bhi talluq hai.
1792 ke Buttonwood Agreement mein brokers ne muahida kiya jo New York Stock Exchange ki tareekhi ibtida samjha jata hai. Isi exchange ka ghair-rasmi naam Big Board bhi hai.

1793 ka Cornwallis Code British India ki adalati aur deewani islahat se mutalliq tha. Charles Cornwallis ki in islahat ne revenue jama karne aur adalati kaam ko alag kiya taake intizami mafadat ka takrao kam ho.
4 May 1799 ko Tipu Sultan Seringapatam ke difa mein mare gaye. Qilay ka suqoot Chauthi Anglo-Mysore jang ka faisla-kun marhala tha aur isi ke saath jang khatam hui.
1804 mein Napoleon Bonaparte ki French emperor ke tor par tajposhi hui. Taqreeb Paris ke Notre-Dame Cathedral mein munaqid hui.
Sweden ne 1809 mein jadeed parliamentary ombudsman, yani mohtasib, ka idara banaya. Is ka kaam sarkari intizam ke khilaf shehri shikayat ki tehqeeq aur qanooni nigrani hai.
Napoleon ka 1812 mein Russia par hamla Leo Tolstoy ke War and Peace ka aham tareekhi pas-e-manzar hai. War and Peace aik tareekhi novel hai, jabke 1812 is mein mutalliq fauji muhim ka saal hai.
18 June 1815 ko Waterloo ki jang mein Napoleon ko aakhri faisla-kun shikast hui. Waterloo aaj ke Belgium ke Walloon Brabant ilaqay mein hai; Paris Napoleon ki tajposhi ka maqam tha, is jang ka nahin.
9 July 1816 ko Tucuman ki congress ne United Provinces ki azadi ka elan kiya. Yeh Argentina ki Spain se azadi ka waqia tha; is se pehle ilaqa muddat tak Spanish hukumat mein raha.

Titu Mir ka asal naam Syed Mir Nisar Ali tha aur woh Bengal mein zulm aur no-abadiyati iqtidar ke khilaf rehnuma thay. November 1831 mein British karwai ke dauran apne baans ke qilay ka difa karte hue mare gaye.
1835 mein Paris ki Havas khabar agency qaim hui. Agence France-Presse apni tareekhi bunyaad isi se jorti hai; Havas purana idara aur AFP us se jure baad ke idaray ka naam hai.
1842 ke Treaty of Nanking, ya Nanjing, ne Britain aur China ki pehli Opium War khatam ki. Nanking aur Nanjing yahan aik hi maqam ke naam hain; yeh jang ke baad ka muahida tha.
1846 ke Oregon Treaty ne Pacific Northwest mein United States aur Great Britain ke sarhadi daway hal kiye. Rocky Mountains se Pacific ki taraf 49th parallel ko bunyadi sarhad banaya gaya.
1846 mein Elias Howe ko lockstitch sewing machine ka aham Amreeki patent mila. Un ki mashhoor silai machine ki pehchan lockstitch mechanism thi; saal patent ka hai.
Karl Marx aur Friedrich Engels ki The Communist Manifesto pehli martaba February 1848 mein shaya hui. Is kitab ke do musannif hain, is liye ise sirf Marx ki tanha tasneef na samjhein.
1848 ke hukm ke tehat Elysee Palace pehle French President Louis-Napoleon Bonaparte ki rehaish bana. Paris ka yeh mahal France ke sadar ki sarkari rehaish aur daftar se pehchana jata hai.
Paul Julius Reuter ne 1851 mein London mein woh daftar qaim kiya jo Reuters bana. Is se pehle woh Aachen aur Brussels ke darmiyan maali khabrein tez pohanchane ke liye kabootar istemal karte thay.
16 April 1853 ko Hindustan ki pehli tijarati musafir rail Bombay ke Bori Bunder se Thane tak chali. Is safar mein Bori Bunder rawangi aur Thane manzil thi.
1857 mein Hindustan ki bari baghawat shuru hui. Mutalliq tareekhi hawalon mein ise First War of Independence bhi kaha gaya hai; dono naam isi waqiay ke liye istemal hote hain.

2 August 1858 ke Government of India Act ne Company ke hukoomati ikhtiyarat British Crown ko diye. Seedhi Crown hukumat shuru hui aur Lord Canning pehle Viceroy bane; Secretary of State ki madad ke liye 15 rukni council thi.
Charles Darwin ki On the Origin of Species 1859 mein pehli martaba shaya hui. Is kitab ne qudrati intikhab, yani natural selection, ke zariye irtiqa ka nazriya pesh kiya.
Suez Canal ki khudai 1859 mein shuru hui aur taqreeban das saal baad 17 November 1869 ko khuli. Is nahar se Europe aur Asia ka samandari safar mukhtasar hua; 1859 aghaz aur 1869 iftitah hai.
Abraham Lincoln ne 1860 ka Amreeki sadarati intikhab jeeta aur 4 March 1861 ko mansab sambhala. Woh sadar muntakhib hone wale pehle Republican umeedwar thay; intikhab aur halaf ke saal alag hain.
1863 mein Henry Dunant samait paanch afrad ne Geneva mein International Committee of the Red Cross ki bunyaad rakhi. ICRC ka headquarters bhi Geneva, Switzerland mein hai.
1864 ki Second Schleswig War mein Prussia aur Austria ne mil kar Denmark ke khilaf jang ki. Is ke baad Schleswig aur Holstein par Danish control khatam hua; ise Danish War bhi kaha jata hai.
April 1865 mein John Wilkes Booth ne Washington, D.C. ke Ford's Theatre mein Abraham Lincoln ko goli mari. Lincoln agle din wafat pa gaye; theatre hamlay ka maqam tha.
1865 mein International Telegraph Union qaim hui, jo aaj ki International Telecommunication Union ki ibtida hai. ITU ka headquarters Geneva, Switzerland mein hai; purane naam mein Telegraph tha.
Suez Canal ki khudai 1859 mein shuru hui aur 17 November 1869 ko jahaz rani ke liye khuli. Taqreeban das saala tameer ke baad Europe aur Asia ke darmiyan behri rasta chhota hua.
1869 mein Japan ka shahi dar-ul-hukumat Kyoto se Tokyo muntaqil hua. Tokyo ka pehla naam Edo tha, jo Meiji daur mein badla; Kyoto purana dar-ul-hukumat tha, Edo Tokyo ka purana naam.
John Davenport ki angrezi kitab An Apology for Mohammed and the Koran ka ibtidai London edition 1869 mein shaya hua.

1873 ki Vienna Meteorological Congress ne mumalik ke darmiyan mausam ke ilmi taawun ko munazzam kiya. Isi silsilay mein International Meteorological Organization bana, jo baad mein WMO mein tabdeel hua.
Japan ka Order of the Rising Sun 1875 mein Meiji daur mein qaim hua. Yeh numayan khidmat aur taalluqat ke aitiraf mein diya jane wala qaumi aizaaz hai.
1878 ka Vernacular Press Act maqami zabanon ke akhbarat par sakht sarkari control ke liye bana. Lord Ripon ki hukumat ne 1882 mein ise khatam kiya; 1878 nafaz aur 1882 mansookhi ka saal hai.
British India ki pehli hum-waqt census 1881 mein hui, jabke 1872 ki ginti mukhtalif ilaqon mein aik waqt par nahin hui thi. Is liye pehli synchronous census poochhi jaye to 1881 murad hai.
Lord Ripon ki 1882 ki qarardad local self-government, yani maqami khud-hukoomati idaron ko mazboot karne ke liye thi. Maqami intizam ke farogh mein isi kirdar se un ka naam khas tor par jura hai.
Lord Ripon ne 1882 mein Vernacular Press Act mansookh kiya. Yeh 1878 ka woh qanoon tha jo maqami zabanon ke akhbarat par sakht pabandiyan lagata tha; mansookhi ko qanoon ke aghaz se alag samjhein.
Lala Lajpat Rai 1882 mein Arya Samaj mein shamil hue. Baad mein woh is ke numayan rehnuma bane; yeh tareekh un ki shamooliyat ki hai, Arya Samaj ke qayam ki nahin.
Indian National Congress ka pehla ijlas December 1885 mein Bombay mein hua. Is ki imarat Gokuldas Tejpal Sanskrit College thi; Bombay shehar aur college ijlas ka asal maqam tha.
Eiffel Tower 1889 ki Paris Universal Exposition ke liye mukammal hua. Exposition Universelle us numaish ka French naam hai.
Adolf Hitler 20 April 1889 ko Braunau am Inn mein paida hua. Yeh shehar Austria mein hai; paidaish ka mulk us ke baad ke Germany mein siyasi kirdar se alag sawal hai.
Frederic Passy ne 1889 mein Inter-Parliamentary Union ke qayam mein hissa liya. Woh France ke siyasi aur aman ke kaamon se wabasta thay; un ka talluq bain-ul-parlimani taawun ki is tanzeem se tha.
New Zealand ke Electoral Act 1893 ne khawateen ko qaumi parliamentary intikhabat mein vote ka qanooni haq diya.
International Olympic Committee ki bunyaad 1894 mein Paris mein rakhi gayi. Is ka headquarters Lausanne, Switzerland mein hai; qayam ka shehar Paris aur markazi daftar Lausanne alag hain.
1897 mein Saragarhi chowki par 36th Sikhs ke 21 sipahiyon ne bari hamla-awar fauj ke khilaf difa kiya. Isi aakhri dam tak muqable ko last stand kaha jata hai.

1900 ki Boxer Rebellion China mein ghair-mulki asar aur Masihi missionary sargarmiyon ke khilaf pur-tashaddud tehreek thi. Boxers Cheeni khufia aur jangju tehreek ke afrad thay, kisi maghribi mulk ki fauj nahin.
1901 ka pehla Nobel Peace Prize Henry Dunant aur Frederic Passy ne mushtarka jeeta. Dunant Red Cross ke aghaz se aur French aman-pasand Passy Inter-Parliamentary Union ke qayam se wabasta thay.
17 December 1903 ko Wright brothers ne kamyab powered aur controlled heavier-than-air parwaz ki. Is ka matlab engine ki taqat se chalne wala, pilot ke qabu mein aur hawa se bhaari hawai jahaz tha.

21 May 1904 ko Paris mein saat qaumi football associations ke numayindon ne FIFA qaim ki. FIFA football ki international federation hai; tareekh, Paris aur saat bani associations aik hi qayam ke pehlu hain.
1905 mein Lord Curzon ke daur ki Bengal taqseem ke khilaf Swadeshi tehreek ubhri. Is mein maqami masnooat ki himayat aur boycott shamil tha; rasmi awami aghaz 7 August ko Calcutta mein hua.
7 August 1905 ko Calcutta ke awami ijlas mein Swadeshi tehreek ka rasmi aghaz hua. Is ka pas-e-manzar Bengal ki taqseem ke khilaf rad-e-amal tha aur tareeqa maqami masnooat aur boycott ki muhim.
Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi ne pehli satyagraha muhim 1906 mein South Africa mein shuru ki. Baad ke Hindustan ke waqiat se pehle is tareeqay ki pehli muhim ka mulk South Africa tha.

1906 mein International Electrotechnical Commission bijli aur electronics ke aalami standards ke liye qaim hui. IEC ka markazi daftar Geneva, Switzerland mein hai; iska kaam technical miyaar banana hai.
Robert Baden-Powell ne August 1907 mein Brownsea Island par tajribati Scout camp lagaya. Yeh jadeed Scouting ki amali ibtida aur baad ki Scout Movement ke liye namoona bana.

Rudyard Kipling ko 1907 mein adab ka Nobel mila aur inaam ke waqt woh United Kingdom mein rehte thay. Un ki paidaish 1865 mein Bombay, aaj ke Mumbai, mein hui; paidaish aur inaam-waqt rehaish alag hain.
1908 mein Belgium ki riyasat ne Congo ka control sambhala. Is ke baad ilaqay ka intizami naam Belgian Congo hua; naam mein Belgian isi riyasati qabzay ki nishandahi karta hai.
1913 mein Rabindranath Tagore ne Literature ka Nobel jeeta aur pehle Asian laureate bane. Un ki Gitanjali, yani Song Offerings, ne un ki shairi ko duniya tak pohanchaya; inaam ka shoba adab tha.
Pierre de Coubertin ne paanch Olympic rings 1913 mein design kiye. Paris Congress mein rasmi ta'aruf 1914 mein hua aur Olympic Games mein jhanda pehli martaba 1920 mein istemal hua.
1914 ki Paris Olympic Congress mein Olympic rings ka rasmi ta'aruf hua. Coubertin ka design 1913 ka tha, jabke Games mein jhande ka pehla istemal 1920 mein hua; teen marahil ke saal alag hain.
1914 mein Archduke Franz Ferdinand ko Sarajevo mein qatl kiya gaya. Is qatl ke baad European ittehadon ka bohran barha aur yeh World War I ke fori asbab mein shamil hua.
Madan Mohan Malaviya ne 1916 mein Banaras Hindu University ke qayam ki qayadat ki. Is ka markazi campus Uttar Pradesh ke shehar Varanasi mein hai; Banaras aur Varanasi aik shehar ke naam hain.
Annie Besant ne 1916 mein All India Home Rule League qaim ki, jabke Tilak ki Home Rule League alag thi. Is League ka naam baad mein aaini tabdeeliyon ke saath Swarajya Sabha rakha gaya.

October 1917 mein Vladimir Lenin ki qayadat mein Bolsheviks ne Russia ki aarzi hukumat ka takhta ulta. Is waqiay ko October Revolution kaha jata hai; Lenin rehnuma aur Bolsheviks iqtidar lene wala giroh tha.
ICRC ko pehla Nobel Peace Prize 1917 mein World War I ke dauran insani khidmat par mila. Isi idaray ko 1944 aur 1963 mein bhi mila, is liye us ke inaamon ki tadaad teen hai.
28 June 1919 ko Germany aur Allied aur Associated Powers ke darmiyan Treaty of Versailles par dastakhat hue. Yeh World War I ke baad jang ki halat khatam karne ke aman bandobast ka aham hissa tha.
1919 mein International Labour Organization, Treaty of Versailles ke aman bandobast ke hissay ke tor par bani. Muahiday ke Part XIII mein ILO ka asal dastoor shamil tha.
Gandhi ki Non-Cooperation Movement ka aghaz 1 August 1920 se mansoob hai. Urdu mein ise Adam Taawun tehreek kehte hain; angrezi aur Urdu naam do alag tehreekain nahin.
1920 mein All India Home Rule League ka naam aaini tabdeeliyon ke saath Swarajya Sabha hua. Annie Besant ne asal League 1916 mein banayi thi; 1916 qayam aur 1920 naam badalne ka saal hai.
Shiromani Akali Dal December 1920 mein qaim hui. Is tanzeem ka numayan kirdar Sikh siyasi numayindagi aur Punjab ke ilaqai masail se mutalliq raha.
Einstein ke 1921 Physics Nobel mein khas tor par photoelectric effect ka qanoon numayan tha. Is kaam ne roshni ke quantum tasawwur ko mazboot kiya; inaam ko sirf relativity se mansoob na karein.
30 December 1922 ko Soviet Union ke qayam ka muahida manzoor hua. USSR ka poora naam Union of Soviet Socialist Republics tha.
TIME magazine ki ishaat March 1923 mein pehle shumaray ke saath shuru hui; yeh us risalay ke aghaz ka saal aur mahina hai.

7 September 1923 ko International Criminal Police Commission qaim hui, jo INTERPOL ki ibtida hai. INTERPOL ka General Secretariat Lyon, France mein hai; ibtidai naam aur baad ka mashhoor naam alag hain.
FIH 7 January 1924 ko field hockey ke aalami intizam aur qawaid ke liye bani. Saat bani associations Austria, Belgium, Czechoslovakia, France, Hungary, Spain aur Switzerland ki thin.
F. Scott Fitzgerald ka The Great Gatsby 1925 mein pehli martaba shaya hua. Yeh Amreeki Jazz Age ki numayan adabi tasveer samjha jata hai; Fitzgerald is novel ke musannif hain.
23 June 1925 ko USSR ki Council of People's Commissars ne Lenin Prizes qaim karne ka farman diya. Baad mein yeh science, adab, fun aur technology ki numayan khidmat par diye gaye.
K. B. Hedgewar ne 1925 mein Nagpur mein Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh qaim ki. RSS isi naam ka mukhtasar roop hai.
Elizabeth II 21 April 1926 ko London ke Mayfair ilaqay mein paida huin. Un ki paidaish ka pata 17 Bruton Street tha.
China ki People's Liberation Army apni ibtida 1 August 1927 ki Nanchang uprising se jorti hai. PLA Cheen ki mushtarka fauji quwwaton ka naam hai; saal fauj ki tareekhi bunyaad ka hai.
1928 ke Amsterdam Summer Olympics mein stadium tower par Olympic flame pehli martaba roshan hui. Yeh stadium mein sholay ki riwayat ka aghaz tha; flame aur rings ke aghaz ko alag rakhein.
Pehle Academy Awards 16 May 1929 ko Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel mein diye gaye. Taqreeb nijji dinner mein hui; Oscars aur Academy Awards isi film inaam ke naam hain.
Pehla FIFA World Cup July 1930 mein Uruguay mein hua. Mezban Uruguay hi pehla champion bana, is liye is pehle tournament mein host aur winner aik hi mulk thay.
Gandhi ne 1930 mein namak qanoon torne ki Salt March se Civil Disobedience Movement shuru ki. Taqreeban 24 din ka march Gujarat ke sahili gaon Dandi pohncha; Dandi march ki manzil thi.
1930 se 1932 ke darmiyan Hindustan ke aaini mustaqbil par teen Round Table Conference sittings huin. Teenon London mein thin; yeh aik hi din ka ijlas nahin balkay alag nashiston ka silsila tha.

11 December 1931 ka Statute of Westminster Dominion parliaments ke qanoon-sazi ikhtiyarat se mutalliq tha. Section 3 ne bahar asar rakhne wale qawaneen ka ikhtiyar diya; Australia ne ise 1942 mein apnaya, asar 3 September 1939 se rakha.
23 September 1932 ko King Abdulaziz ne mukhtalif ilaqon ko yakja karke Kingdom of Saudi Arabia ka naam apnaya. Saudi National Day isi ittehad ki yaad mein 23 September ko hota hai.
Adolf Hitler 30 January 1933 ko Germany ka Chancellor muqarrar hua. Isi saal Nazi party ne riyasati iqtidar mazboot karke aamriyat qaim ki; yeh us ki paidaish nahin balkay iqtidar ka marhala hai.
15 September 1935 ko Nazi Germany ne Nuremberg Laws manzoor kiye. Reich Citizenship Law aur German Blood and Honor Law ne nasli imtiyaz ko qanooni shakal di.
1936 mein Jorge Mario Bergoglio Buenos Aires, Argentina mein paida hue. Yehi shakhs baad mein Pope Francis bane; Jorge Mario un ka paidaishi naam aur Francis papal naam tha.
Napoleon Hill ki Think and Grow Rich 1937 mein pehli martaba shaya hui. Yeh zaati kamyabi aur zehni rawaiye par self-help kitab hai.
1939 mein Germany ne Poland par hamla kiya, jis se Europe mein World War II shuru hui. Do din baad Britain aur France ne Germany ke khilaf jang ka elan kiya aur jang phail gayi.

1939 mein Poland par German hamlay ke do din baad United Kingdom aur France ne Germany ke khilaf jang ka elan kiya. Yeh Poland par hamlay ka rad-e-amal tha aur European jang ko wasee karne wala marhala bana.
1941 ka Atlantic Charter Amreeki sadar Franklin D. Roosevelt aur British PM Winston Churchill ka mushtarka elan tha. Is mein usool bayan hue; yeh rasmi dastakhat wala treaty nahin tha.
1941 mein Japan ne Amreeki naval base Pearl Harbor par achanak hamla kiya. Agle din, 8 December 1941 ko, U.S. Congress ne Japan ke khilaf jang manzoor ki aur America jang mein dakhil hua.
8 December 1941 ko U.S. Congress ne Japan ke khilaf jang ka elan manzoor kiya. Is se aik din pehle Japan ka Pearl Harbor par hamla hua tha; hamla aur rasmi elan-e-jang alag din thay.
1942 mein Japanese pesh-qadmi ke baad Singapore mein pehli Indian National Army bani. Captain Mohan Singh ne is pehli INA ko munazzam kiya aur ibtidai qayadat ki.

1 January 1942 ko 26 ittehadi riyasaton ki Declaration by United Nations mein yeh naam rasmi tor par aaya. Naam Franklin D. Roosevelt ne tajweez kiya tha; yeh 1945 mein UN idaray ke qayam se pehle ka elan hai.
Australia ne Statute of Westminster Adoption Act 1942 se purane statute ko apnaya. Is ka qanooni asar 3 September 1939 se rakha gaya, is liye adoption ka saal aur pichhli moassar tareekh alag hain.
Jean-Paul Sartre ki Being and Nothingness 1943 mein World War II ke dauran shaya hui. Is ka French unwan L'etre et le neant hai aur mauzu wajoodiyat, yani existentialism, ka falsafa hai.

July 1944 mein Bretton Woods mein 44 mumalik jama hue aur World Bank ke IBRD aur IMF ke dhanchay ki bunyaad bani. Yeh conference aur muahiday tayyar hone ka marhala tha, har idaray ke rasmi nafaz ki tareekh nahin.

22 July 1944 ko Bretton Woods Conference ke aakhri din IMF Articles of Agreement manzoor hue. Isi conference mein World Bank aur IMF ke idaray tay hue; articles ki manzoori ko baad ke nafaz se alag rakhein.
7 December 1944 ko Convention on International Civil Aviation par dastakhat hue. Is ka mashhoor naam Chicago Convention hai aur yeh bain-ul-aqwami shehri hawabazi se mutalliq muahida hai.
26 June 1945 ko San Francisco Conference mein UN Charter par dastakhat hue. Zaroori tauseeq ke baad 24 October 1945 ko yeh nafiz hua; June dastakhat aur October idaray ke rasmi wajood ka marhala hai.
24 October 1945 ko UN Charter nafiz hua aur United Nations rasmi tor par bani. San Francisco mein 50 mumalik thay; Poland ke baad mein dastakhat se asal arkan 51 hue, aur 24 October UN Day hai.
Poland ne 15 October 1945 ko UN Charter par baad mein dastakhat kiye. Is se San Francisco ke 50 dastakhat karne wale mumalik ke saath asal UN arkan ki tadaad 51 hui.
27 December 1945 ko IMF ke Articles of Agreement nafiz hue aur idara rasmi tor par bana. Is ka dhanchay tay karne wala Bretton Woods ijlas 1944 ka tha, is liye conference aur qayam ke saal alag hain.
1945 mein Hiroshima par giraye gaye atom bomb ka code name Little Boy tha. Nagasaki par 9 August ko giraya gaya bomb Fat Man tha; dono shehron aur bombon ke naam aik doosre se na milayein.
9 August 1945 ko Nagasaki par Fat Man naam ka atom bomb giraya gaya. Hiroshima ka bomb Little Boy tha; Nagasaki-Fat Man aur Hiroshima-Little Boy do alag joray hain.
World War II ke baad 1945 mein Korea ko aarzi tor par 38th parallel ke saath taqseem kiya gaya. Shumal Soviet aur junoob Amreeki occupation zone tha; line aik arz-e-balad hai.
1945 mein Food and Agriculture Organization bani taake ghiza, zaraat aur bhook par aalami taawun ho. FAO UN ka specialised idara hai aur iska headquarters Rome, Italy mein hai.
UNESCO ka dastoor 16 November 1945 ko London mein manzoor aur 4 November 1946 ko nafiz hua. Is ka headquarters Paris, France mein hai; manzoori, nafaz aur daftar ka maqam mukhtalif baatein hain.
March 1945 mein Arab riyasaton ne Cairo mein League of Arab States ka muahida kiya. Arab League isi idaray ka mashhoor naam hai aur iska markazi daftar bhi Cairo, Egypt mein hai.

1945 mein Democratic Republic of Vietnam ka elan hua aur Ho Chi Minh is ke pehle sadar bane. Woh Vietnam ki azadi ki tehreek ke markazi rehnuma thay; elan aur pehli sadarat aik hi nayi riyasat se mutalliq hain.
25 May 1946 ko Jordan azad hua aur Abdullah I is ke pehle badshah bane. Isi azadi ki yaad mein 25 May Jordan ka Independence Day hai.
29 November 1947 ko UN General Assembly ne Resolution 181 (II) se Palestine ke Partition Plan ki sifarish ki. Is mein Arab aur Jewish riyasaton ka mansuba tha; yeh General Assembly ki sifarish thi.
13 September 1948 ko India ne Hyderabad ke khilaf Operation Polo shuru ki, jis ke baad riyasat Indian Union ka hissa bani. Ise 1961 ke Goa wale Operation Vijay se alag rakhein.
14 May 1948 ko David Ben-Gurion ne Tel Aviv ke museum mein Israel ke qayam ka elan parha.
Hans J. Morgenthau ki Politics Among Nations ka pehla edition 1948 mein shaya hua; kitab ka unwan aur musannif is tareekhi ishaat ke bunyadi pehlu hain.

10 December 1948 ko Universal Declaration of Human Rights manzoor hua, jis ki yaad Human Rights Day hai. Article 1 insani azadi aur izzat-o-huqooq mein barabari bayan karta hai; musallah jang chherne ka haq is elan mein nahin.
March 1948 mein International Maritime Organization qaim karne wala convention manzoor hua. IMO ka headquarters London mein hai; 1948 convention ki manzoori ka saal hai.
1949 mein Mao Zedong ki qayadat mein People's Republic of China ka elan hua. Yeh Cheeni inqilab ki kamyabi ke baad nayi awaami jamhooria ke qayam ka marhala tha.

1949 se mainland China aur Taiwan par alag intizami hukumatain kaam karne lagin. Republic of China ki markazi hukumat December 1949 mein Taipei muntaqil hui; yeh khana-jangi ke aakhri marhalay ka pas-e-manzar hai.
1949 ke London Declaration ne republic banne wale mumalik ke Commonwealth mein rehne ka rasta wazeh kiya. Khas tor par India ke jamhooria banne ke bawajood rukniyat jari rakhne ka usool tasleem hua.
NATO ka pehla headquarters 1949 mein London ke 13 Belgrave Square mein bana. Yeh 1952 mein Paris aur 1967 mein Brussels muntaqil hua.
India ka aain 26 January 1950 ko nafiz hua, isi liye 26 January Republic Day hai. Article 394 chand fori provisions ke ilawa baqi aain ki isi commencement date ko bayan karta hai.
UN General Assembly ne UNHCR 1950 mein qaim kiya aur is ne 1951 mein kaam shuru kiya. Refugees aur be-ghar afrad ke tahaffuz ke is idaray ka headquarters Geneva mein hai.
Pakistan 11 July 1950 ko International Monetary Fund ka rukun bana. Yeh membership ki ibtidai tareekh hai; baad ke qarz ya lending arrangements ki tareekhein aur tadaad is se alag maamla hain.
Libya ne 1951 mein azadi hasil ki aur Idris I badshah bane. Woh azad Libya ke pehle aur wahid badshah thay; azadi aur badshahat ka aghaz isi waqiay mein jura hai.
Pehle Asian Games 1951 mein New Delhi mein hue. In ka mamool ka waqfa chaar saal hai; 1951 pehle muqablon ka saal aur New Delhi pehla mezban shehar tha.
International Organization for Migration December 1951 mein bani aur agle saal amali kaam shuru kiya. Hijrat se mutalliq IOM ka headquarters Geneva, Switzerland mein hai.
1951 mein World Meteorological Organization ko UN specialised agency ka darja mila. WMO ka headquarters Geneva mein hai; yahan saal UN se specialised agency ke talluq ka hai.

Elizabeth II apne walid George VI ki wafat par 6 February 1952 ko takht par baithein. Un ka daur 8 September 2022 tak 70 saal aur 214 din raha; 2015 mein unhon ne Victoria ka British muddat ka record toda.
December 1952 mein London ki Great Smog mein dhuaan aur dhund mil kar sehat ka jaan-lewa bohran bane. Is waqiay ne hawa ki aloodgi ke khatray wazeh kiye aur Clean Air Act 1956 ki raah bani.
Dwight D. Eisenhower ne January 1953 mein apni pehli Amreeki sadarati muddat shuru ki. Woh United States ke 34wein sadar thay.
18 se 24 April 1955 tak Asian-African Conference Bandung, Indonesia mein hui. President Sukarno ne iftitah kiya; Indonesia mulk aur Bandung mezban shehar tha, Jakarta nahin.
14 May 1955 ko Soviet Union aur mashriqi Europe ke ittehadiyon ne Warsaw Pact banaya. Yeh mashriqi bloc ka difai ittehad tha aur NATO ke qayam ke chhay saal baad bana.
Britain ka Clean Air Act 1956 hawa mein dhuein ki aloodgi kam karne se mutalliq tha. Is ka aham pas-e-manzar December 1952 ki London Great Smog thi, jis ne aloodgi ka sehat par khatra dikhaya.
Soviet Union ne 4 October 1957 ko duniya ka pehla masnoi satellite Sputnik 1 launch kiya. Taqreeban teen maah baad 4 January 1958 ko yeh zameen ki fiza mein dobara dakhil hua.
4 January 1958 ko Sputnik 1 dobara zameen ki fiza mein dakhil hua. Isay Soviet Union ne 4 October 1957 ko launch kiya tha, is liye launch aur re-entry ke darmiyan taqreeban teen maah thay.
1958 ki pehli UN Conference on the Law of the Sea Geneva mein hui. Is mein chaar alag conventions manzoor hue; sawal conference ke shehar aur manzoor muahidon ki tadaad se mutalliq hai.
Pele ne 1958 ke Sweden World Cup mein Brazil ke saath apna pehla FIFA World Cup jeeta. Unhon ne Brazil ki taraf se khel kar kul teen World Cups jeete; Sweden us pehli fatah ka mezban tha.
All Pakistan Music Conference ka aghaz 15 September 1959 ko Lahore mein hua; is idaray ki ibtida ka waqia Lahore se mutalliq hai.
1 May 1960 ko Francis Gary Powers ka Amreeki U-2 jasoosi tayyara Soviet fazai hudood mein giraya gaya. Is se Sard Jang ka safarti bohran paida hua aur Paris summit bhi mutasir hui.
1960 mein Eisenhower ne UN General Assembly mein mushtarka food-aid scheme tajweez ki. Is ke baad 1961 mein World Food Programme tajribati bunyaad par bana.

1960 ke Treaty of Guarantee mein Cyprus ki azadi aur aaini tarteeb ke teen zamin Greece, Turkiye aur United Kingdom thay. Agar sawal sirf do naam de to teesray Britain ko bhi isi fehrist ka hissa samjhein.
Pakistan ne men's Olympic hockey mein 1960 mein gold jeeta. Is ke doosre gold 1968 aur 1984 mein thay, is liye in teen saalon ko Olympic hockey ke aik silsilay mein parhein.

British wakeel Peter Benenson ki 1961 ki appeal se Amnesty International ki tehreek shuru hui. Baad mein yeh insani huqooq ki aalami ghair-sarkari tanzeem bani; Benenson is aghaz se wabasta bani thay.
1961 mein OECD ne OEEC ki jagah kaam shuru kiya. OECD ka poora naam Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development aur headquarters Paris hai; OEEC is ka peshro idara tha.

1961 mein Goa aur doosri Portuguese no-abadiyon ke liye Indian fauji karwai Operation Vijay kehlayi. Hyderabad ke khilaf 1948 ki karwai Operation Polo thi; milte-julte operations ke naam aur ilaqay alag hain.
Algeria ne 1962 mein France se azadi hasil ki. Is se pehle ilaqa French no-abadiyati hukumat mein tha.
1963 mein John F. Kennedy ki wafat ke din Lyndon B. Johnson ne Amreeki sadarat ka halaf liya. Halaf Dallas ke Love Field par khare presidential tayyaray Air Force One mein hua.

Regional Cooperation for Development 1964 mein qaim hui. RCD baad ki Economic Cooperation Organization ka peshro idara thi; dono naam aik waqt ke do alag idaray samajhne ke bajaye pehle aur baad ka silsila hain.

1965 mein Canada ka surkh-o-safed maple-leaf parcham Parliament Hill par pehli martaba lehraya gaya. Maple ka patta Canada ki purani qaumi pehchan bhi hai, is liye isi alamat ko parcham par jagah mili.
1966 mein Huey P. Newton aur Bobby Seale ne Oakland, California mein Black Panther Party banayi. Is ka pas-e-manzar African American shehri huqooq aur samaji insaf ki tehreek tha.

8 August 1967 ko Bangkok Declaration se ASEAN bani; bani Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore aur Thailand thay. Secretariat Jakarta mein hai, is liye qayam ka shehar Bangkok aur daftar Jakarta alag hain.
June 1967 ki jang mein Israel ne Syria ke Golan Heights par qabza kiya. Golan aik buland basaltic satah-murtafa hai jo qareebi wadiyon aur Sea of Galilee se oonchi hai; UN ise Syrian Golan kehti hai.
Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah ne 5 October 1967 ko Brunei ka takht sambhala; un ke daur-e-hukumat ka aghaz isi din hua.
Sweden ke central bank Sveriges Riksbank ne Economic Sciences ka inaam 1968 mein qaim kiya. Yeh Alfred Nobel ke asal inaamat mein nahin tha; baad mein Nobel inaamon ke saath diya jane laga.
1968 mein Pakistan ne Olympic men's hockey ka gold medal jeeta. Olympic hockey ke Pakistan ke teen gold saal 1960, 1968 aur 1984 hain; 1968 in mein darmiyani fatah hai.
25 September 1969 ko Rabat, Morocco ke summit mein OIC ki bunyaad pari. Muslim mumalik ke taawun ke is platform ka General Secretariat Jeddah, Saudi Arabia mein hai.

Ustad Bade Fateh Ali Khan ko 1969 mein classical music par Pride of Performance mila. Woh Patiala gharanay ki khayal gayaki se wabasta thay aur bhai Amanat Ali Khan ke saath is riwayat ko mashhoor kiya.
NPT 1968 mein dastakhat ke liye khula aur 5 March 1970 ko nafiz hua. Is ke maqsad nuclear hathiyaron ka phelao rokna, pur-aman nuclear taawun aur hathiyar kam karna hain.
25 October 1971 ko UN General Assembly Resolution 2758 ne PRC ko China ka qanooni numayinda tasleem kiya. Matn mein Chiang Kai-shek ke numayindon ko un ki jagah se nikalne ka faisla bhi tha.
16 December 1971 ko Dhaka mein Pakistani afwaj ke hathyar dalne ki taqreeb hui. Bangladesh ise Victory Day ke tor par manata hai; azadi ki siyasi aur fauji jang is din se pehle kai maah jari thi.
1971 mein Bangladesh ne azadi ka elan kiya aur jang-e-azadi lari. Is ka Independence Day 26 March hai; elan-e-azadi ki tareekh ko baad ke Victory Day se alag samjhein.
1971 mein aaj ka World Economic Forum, European Management Forum ke naam se qaim hua. Baad mein naam World Economic Forum rakha gaya; is liye ibtidai naam mein European tha.
1971 mein table-tennis ke tabadlon se U.S.-China ping-pong diplomacy shuru hui. Is safarti rastay ke baad President Richard Nixon ne February 1972 mein China ka tareekhi daura kiya.
24 October 1971 ko Barcelona ke pehle Men's Hockey World Cup final mein Pakistan ne Spain ko 1-0 se haraya. Spain mezban aur runner-up tha, jabke Pakistan pehla champion bana.
Bhutan ne 1971 mein archery, yani teer-andazi, ko qaumi khel ka darja diya. Yeh khel us mulk ki numayan saqafati riwayat bhi hai.
1972 mein nayi jamhoori aaini haisiyat ke saath Ceylon ka naam Sri Lanka rakha gaya. Ceylon purana aur Sri Lanka naya rasmi naam hai; yeh do mukhtalif mulk nahin.
1972 mein United Nations Environment Programme qaim hua. UNEP ka headquarters Nairobi, Kenya mein bana; yeh UN ka maholiyat se mutalliq programme hai.
Moro National Liberation Front 1972 mein qaim hua. MNLF Philippines ke junoobi hissay ki musallah aur siyasi tehreek thi; Moro naam ko isi ilaqai pas-e-manzar mein samjhein.
Richard Nixon ne February 1972 mein China ka daura kiya. Is se pehle 1971 mein table-tennis ke tabadlon wali ping-pong diplomacy se dono mulkon ke darmiyan safarti rasta khula tha.
1973 mein Daoud Khan ne iqtidar le kar republic banayi aur Zahir Shah ki badshahat khatam hui. Zahir Shah 1933 se 1973 tak hukmaran aur Afghanistan ke aakhri badshah thay.
UN ne World Environment Day 1972 mein qaim kiya, magar pehli baqaida taqreeb 1973 mein hui. Yeh din har saal 5 June ko mahol ke tahaffuz aur awaami aagahi ke liye hota hai.
1972 mein Watergate complex ke Democratic National Committee daftar mein naqab se siyasi bohran shuru hua. Tehqeeqat aur impeachment ke dabao par Richard Nixon ne August 1974 mein sadarat chhor di.
1974 mein oil crisis ke baad energy security aur taawun ke liye International Energy Agency bani. IEA ka headquarters Paris mein OECD ke intizami mahol ke andar hai.

1975 ka pehla men's Cricket World Cup England mein hua. London ke Lord's final mein West Indies ne Australia ko hara kar pehla title jeeta; England host, West Indies winner aur Australia runner-up tha.
1975 Men's Hockey World Cup ka final Kuala Lumpur mein India aur Pakistan ke darmiyan hua. India champion bana aur Pakistan runner-up raha; ise isi saal ke cricket World Cup se alag rakhein.
Indira Gandhi ki premiership mein 25 June 1975 ko India ki Internal Emergency ka elan hua. Is ke baad siyasi azadiyon par wasee pabandiyan lagin; saal aur din aaini emergency ke elan ke hain.
Tiger Woods 30 December 1975 ko paida hue. Woh golf ke mashhoor khiladi aur kai bare muqablon ke fateh hain.
Arab Monetary Fund ka agreement 1976 mein hua aur baad mein Abu Dhabi se operations shuru hue. Is ka mustaqil headquarters Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates mein hai.

1976 ke basketball merger mein American Basketball Association ki chaar franchises NBA mein shamil huin. NBA ka poora naam National Basketball Association hai, jo North America ki professional league hai.
1974 ki World Food Conference ke baad IFAD 1977 mein bain-ul-aqwami maali idaray ke tor par bana. Is ka maqsad dehati ghurbat aur ghizai tahaffuz par kaam karna hai, aur headquarters Rome mein hai.
1978 ke Camp David Accords ne Egypt aur Israel ke aman amal ki bunyaad rakhi. In koshishon par Egypt ke Anwar Sadat aur Israel ke Menachem Begin ko mushtarka Nobel Peace Prize mila.
1978 mein Helsinki Watch qaim hui, jis se baad mein Human Rights Watch ne taraqqi ki. Human Rights Watch ka headquarters New York hai; Helsinki Watch ibtidai tanzeemi naam tha.
World Bank ne 1978 mein pehli World Development Report jari ki. Baad mein yeh salana numayan publication bani jo aalami taraqqi ke kisi aham mauzu ka tehqeeqi jaiza deti hai.

1979 ke Iranian Revolution ke markazi rehnuma Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini thay. Mohammad Reza Shah January mein chale gaye, February mein un ki hukumat khatam hui aur badshahat ki jagah Islamic Republic bani.
24 December 1979 ko Soviet afwaj Afghanistan mein dakhil huin aur Kabul ke aham maqamat par qabza kiya. Christmas Eve ke is dakhle se taweel jang shuru hui; Kabul mulk ka dar-ul-hukumat tha.
RCD 1964 se 1979 tak faal rahi aur 1979 mein us ki sargarmiyan ruk gayin. Yeh Regional Cooperation for Development ka operations band hone ka saal hai, ibtidai qayam ka nahin.

1982 ke UN Convention on the Law of the Sea ko mukhtasaran UNCLOS kehte hain. Baad mein Philippines ne South China Sea ke behri huqooq par China ke khilaf isi ke Annex VII ke tehat arbitration shuru ki.
Jahangir Khan ne 1982 se 1991 tak lagatar das British Open squash titles jeete. Yeh aik hi tournament ki musalsal saalana fatahon ka record hai, tamam muqablon ki kul tadaad nahin.
Ethiopia ka 1983-1985 ka qahat 1983 mein shuru hua aur agle barson mein shadeed hua. Shumali ilaqon Tigray aur Wello mein barish ki nakami se faslain tabah huin aur ghizai bohran barha.
Muhammad Yunus ne Bangladesh mein Grameen Bank qaim kiya jo 1983 mein baqaida bank bana. Is idaray ne chhote qarzon ke microcredit model ko duniya mein mashhoor kiya.
Morocco 1984 mein Organisation of African Unity se alag hua. Is ki janashheen African Union mein January 2017 ko wapas aaya; 1984 alahdagi aur 2017 wapsi ka saal hai.
Pakistan ne 1984 mein Olympic men's hockey ka gold jeeta. Is ke pehle do gold 1960 aur 1968 mein thay, is liye 1984 is teen-fatah silsilay ka teesra saal hai.
8 December 1985 ko South Asian rehnumaon ne Dhaka mein SAARC Charter par dastakhat kiye. Isi se janubi Asia ki ilaqai taawun ki tanzeem bani; Dhaka qayam ka shehar tha.
1985 mein Iran, Pakistan aur Turkiye ne RCD ki jagah Economic Cooperation Organization banayi. ECO naya naam aur janashheen idara tha; yehi teen mulk is ke bani thay.
1985 mein Asia Watch Asia ke insani huqooq ki khilaf-warziyon ki nigrani aur huqooq ke farogh ke liye bani. Baad mein mukhtalif ilaqai Watch committees Human Rights Watch ke tehat jama huin.
1986 ke World Open final mein New Zealand ke Ross Norman ne Jahangir Khan ko haraya. Is se taqreeban paanch saal aur 555 lagatar fatahon ka unbeaten silsila khatam hua.
December 1987 mein maqbooza West Bank aur Gaza mein First Intifada shuru hui. Yeh Israeli qabzay ke khilaf Falasteeni awaami tehreek thi; Intifada is uprising ka naam hai.
14 April 1988 ko Afghanistan se mutalliq Geneva Accords par dastakhat hue. Us waqt Soviet rehnuma Mikhail Gorbachev thay, jinhon ne afwaj ke inkhala ka timetable pesh kiya tha.
1989 mein Financial Action Task Force maali jaraim ke khilaf aalami policy aur standards banane ke liye bani. FATF ki ibtidai zimmedari money laundering ke khilaf iqdamaat thi.
18 June 1989 ko Burma ne UN ko apna rasmi English naam Myanmar hone ki ittila di. Burma purana aur Myanmar naya naam hai; yeh usi riyasat ke naam ki tabdeeli thi.
Security Service Act 1989 ne British MI5 ke wajood aur faraiz ko wazeh qanooni bunyaad di. MI5 andarooni salamti aur counter-intelligence ka idara hai, jabke bahar ki intelligence se MI6 wabasta hai.
Nelson Mandela 27 saala qaid ke baad 11 February 1990 ko Victor Verster Prison se riha hue. Jail ka naam baad mein Drakenstein Correctional Centre hua; Mandela ki sadarat 1994 mein shuru hui.
2 August 1990 ko Iraqi afwaj Kuwait mein dakhil huin aur hamsaya riyasat par qabzay ki karwai shuru ki.

26 December 1991 ko Soviet Union ki rasmi tahleel mukammal hui aur 15 republics azad riyasatain banin. Gorbachev aik din pehle mustafi hue; Russia ne UN rukniyat aur Security Council ki mustaqil seat jari rakhi.
Rio Earth Summit 3 se 14 June 1992 tak Rio de Janeiro, Brazil mein hui. Is ka rasmi naam UN Conference on Environment and Development, ya UNCED, tha; Earth Summit isi conference ka mashhoor naam hai.

Imran Khan ki captaincy mein Pakistan ne 1992 ke Melbourne Cricket Ground final mein England ko 22 runs se haraya. Yeh Pakistan ka pehla men's Cricket World Cup tha; Australia final ka mezban mulk tha.
1992 mein Babri Masjid Ayodhya mein girayi gayi. Ayodhya India ki riyasat Uttar Pradesh mein Sarayu darya ke kinare hai.
Hassan Nasrallah 1992 mein Hezbollah ke secretary-general muntakhib hue. Woh 2024 mein wafat tak isi mansab par rahe.

1993 ke Oslo Accords ka Declaration of Principles Israel aur Palestine Liberation Organization ke darmiyan tha. Yeh un ke aman amal ka bunyadi muahida bana; PLO Falasteeni taraf ki numayinda tanzeem thi.

Samuel Huntington ne 1993 ke Foreign Affairs mazmoon mein tehzeebon ke darmiyan tanazaat ka nazriya pesh kiya. Un ki daleel mein Cold War ke baad bari saqafati aur tehzeebi ikaiyan aham thin; yeh un ka thesis tha.
Pehla World Water Day 22 March 1993 ko UN qarardad ke baad manaya gaya. Yeh din meethe pani ki ahmiyat aur mehfooz pani tak rasai ke masail par tawajjoh dilata hai.

1993 mein UN General Assembly Resolution 48/141 ne High Commissioner for Human Rights ka office banaya. Jose Ayala Lasso ne 1994 mein yeh naya mansab sambhala; office banne aur pehle sarbarah ke saal alag hain.

1994 ke pehle mukammal kaseer-nasli qaumi election ke baad Nelson Mandela South Africa ke sadar bane. Apartheid nasl ki bunyaad par huqooq aur siyasi taqat alag karta tha; is election se naye jamhoori daur ki raah bani.

Mandela ki Long Walk to Freedom 1994 mein shaya hui aur un ki zindagi, apartheid ke khilaf jang aur qaid bayan karti hai. Richard Stengel ne maswada tayyar karne mein madad ki; 27 saala qaid ke 18 saal Robben Island par guzray.

Palau 1 October 1994 ko azad hua aur UN ka aakhri trust ilaqa khatam hua. Is ke baad Trusteeship Council ne mamool ki karwai moattal ki; ilaqay ki azadi aur council ki amali zimmedari ka ikhtitam jure hain.
Taliban tehreek 1994 mein Kandahar aur us ke gird junoobi Afghanistan mein ubhri. Taliban, talib ki jama hai; ibtidai arkan mazhabi madaris ke talaba thay.
1994 Men's Hockey World Cup final mein Pakistan aur Netherlands 1-1 par barabar thay. Pakistan ne penalty strokes ka muqabla 4-3 se jeeta; match score aur penalty score alag hain.
UN General Assembly ne 1994 mein 17 June ko World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought muqarrar kiya. Is ka mauzu zameen ki zarkhaizi, khushk-sali aur paidar intizam hai.
Singapore ke PM Goh Chok Tong ne 1994 mein ASEM ka khayal pesh kiya. Pehla summit 1996 mein Bangkok, Thailand mein hua.
1 January 1995 ko Marrakesh Agreement nafiz hone par WTO wajood mein aayi. GATT ke tehat chalne wala tijarati nizam is tarah aik mustaqil aalami tanzeem mein badla.
1996 mein pehla ASEM summit Bangkok mein hua. Is se pehle 1994 mein Singapore ke PM Goh Chok Tong ne tasawwur pesh kiya tha; Bangkok conference ka maqam tha.
Al Jazeera ki Arabic nashriyat 1996 mein Doha se shuru huin. Doha Qatar ka dar-ul-hukumat hai.
Hotmail ki web-based email service 1996 mein awaam ke liye launch hui. Sabeer Bhatia aur Jack Smith is ke shareek bani thay; public launch ko company ki ibtidai tameer se alag samjhein.
1996 mein Shahid Afridi ne Nairobi mein Sri Lanka ke khilaf sirf 37 balls par apni tareekhi ODI century mukammal ki.
15 June 1997 ko Istanbul Declaration se D-8 qaim hui. Developing Eight Organization for Economic Cooperation aath taraqqi-pazeer Muslim-aksariyati mumalik ke maashi taawun ke liye bani.

1997 mein Saeed Anwar ne Chennai mein India ke khilaf ODI mein 194 runs banaye, jo muddat tak record rahe. 2010 mein Sachin Tendulkar ne South Africa ke khilaf 200 not out se pehli men's ODI double century ki.
Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan 1997 mein London mein ilaj ke dauran wafat pa gaye aur baad mein Pakistan mein dafan hue. Un ki awaaz ne qawwali ko aalami shohrat di.
Euro 1 January 1999 ko hisab-kitab aur ghair-naqad len-den ke liye launch hua. Notes aur sikke 2002 mein aaye; 1999 currency ka electronic aghaz aur 2002 cash ki gardish hai.
1999 ke aakhir mein TIME ne Albert Einstein ko Person of the Century chuna. Is intikhab ki wajah beesween sadi par un ka ghair-mamooli sainsi asar tha; yeh TIME ka unwan tha.
Hugo Chavez ne 1998 ka election jeeta aur February 1999 mein Venezuela ki sadarat sambhali. Woh 2013 mein wafat tak sadar rahe; intikhab aur pehli muddat ke aghaz mein saal ka farq hai.
15 June 2001 ko Shanghai mein Shanghai Cooperation Organization ke qayam ke elan par dastakhat hue. SCO ka naam bhi isi mezban shehar se jura hai.
11 September 2001 ke hamlon ke baad New York ke purane Twin Towers ka maqam Ground Zero kehlaya. Qaumi yaadgar ke do hauz unhi bunyadon par hain jahan North aur South Towers thay.
China ki World Trade Organization ki rukniyat 11 December 2001 se moassar hui. Yeh China ke member banne ki tareekh hai, WTO ke apne qayam ki nahin.
2002 mein Euro ke notes aur sikke awaami gardish mein aaye. Currency ka ghair-naqad aur hisabi istemal 1 January 1999 se tha, is liye dono saal mukhtalif launch marahil dikhate hain.
International Criminal Court ka Rome Statute 1 July 2002 ko nafiz hua. Is ke Article 3 ke mutabiq adalat ka maqam The Hague, Netherlands hai; Rome statute ka naam hai, court ka daftar nahin.

Hillary Rodham Clinton ki khud-navisht Living History 2003 mein shaya hui. Un ki Hard Choices 2014 mein Secretary of State ke tajurbon par aur What Happened 2017 mein aayi; teen unwanon ke saal alag hain.

2003 Cricket World Cup mein Shoaib Akhtar ne England ke khilaf 161.3 km/h ki ball ki. Isay international cricket ki tez-tareen record-shuda ball mana gaya; raftaar ko kilometre per hour mein samjhein.

April 2004 mein Brian Lara ne Antigua Recreation Ground par England ke khilaf 400 not out banaye. Yeh men's Test cricket ki sab se bari infiradi innings hai; 400 not out ka matlab woh out nahin hue thay.
12th SAARC Summit 4 se 6 January 2004 tak Pakistan ke dar-ul-hukumat Islamabad mein hui.
2004 Athens Olympics mein Amir Khan ne men's lightweight boxing ka silver medal jeeta. Woh Pakistani-nazhad British boxer hain.

Sergey Lavrov 2004 mein pehli martaba Russia ke Foreign Minister muqarrar hue. Yeh tareekh un ke mansab ke aghaz se mutalliq hai; baad ki current office-holder maloomat ko tareekh ke saath dekhna chahiye.
Kyoto Protocol 1997 mein adopt hua, magar zaroori tauseeq ke baad 16 February 2005 ko nafiz hua. Is maholiyati muahiday mein adoption aur entry into force ke saal alag hain.
March 2005 ki Tulip Revolution Kyrgyzstan ki awaami tehreek thi. Is ke natijay mein President Askar Akayev iqtidar se hatay aur mulk chhor gaye.
Lionel Messi ne 2005 mein Argentina ki senior national football team ke liye apna pehla international match khela.
Angela Merkel 2005 mein Germany ki Chancellor banin aur December 2021 tak rahin. Bundestag ne Olaf Scholz ko janashheen chuna, jis se Merkel ki taweel chancellorship khatam hui.

2006 mein UN General Assembly ne Human Rights Council banayi aur purani Commission on Human Rights ki jagah di. Purana Commission aam tor par Geneva mein salana ijlas karta tha; Council us ka janashheen idara hai.
WikiLeaks 2006 mein qaim hui aur Julian Assange is ke bani aur markazi muntazimeen mein shamil thay. Assange Australia ke shehri hain; idaray ka qayam aur bani ka mulk do mutalliq pehlu hain.
North Korea ka pehla elan-shuda nuclear test October 2006 mein hua. Doosra 25 May 2009 ko kiya gaya; pehle aur doosre tajrabay ke saal aik doosre se alag rakhein.
EU ke Regulation (EC) No 1922/2006 ne European Institute for Gender Equality qaim kiya. EIGE gender equality ke liye data, research aur amali madad deta hai; GDPR mukhtalif 2016 ka qanoon hai.
April 2007 ke New Delhi mein 14th SAARC Summit par Afghanistan ko poori rukniyat mili. Is ke shamil hone se arkan saat se aath hue; Afghanistan naya aathwan rukun tha.
Samjhauta Express par bombing 18 February 2007 ki raat hui; yeh is train par hamlay ki mukammal tareekh hai.
Ban Ki-moon 2007 se 2016 tak UN Secretary-General rahe. Woh is mansab ke aathwein sarbarah thay.
28 May 2008 ko Nepal ki Constituent Assembly ne badshahat khatam karke federal republic qarar di. Yeh sadiyon purani monarchy se jamhoori nizam ki rasmi tabdeeli ka din tha.
Beijing ne 2008 Summer Olympics ki mezbani ki aur baad mein 2022 Winter Olympics bhi yahin hue. Dono editions China mein thay, magar garmayi aur sarmayi khelon ke saal alag hain.
King of Pop ke naam se mashhoor Michael Jackson 25 June 2009 ko Los Angeles mein wafat pa gaye.

Younus Khan ki captaincy mein Pakistan ne 2009 T20 World Cup ke Lord's final mein Sri Lanka ko haraya. Yeh Pakistan ka pehla men's T20 world title tha; captain ne fatah ke foran baad T20 internationals se retirement kahi.
May 2009 mein Sri Lankan faujon ne LTTE ko shikast di aur civil war khatam hui. LTTE aakhri marhalay mein shikast khane wali tanzeem thi; 2009 jang ke ikhtitam ka saal hai.
November 2009 mein UN General Assembly ne 18 July ko Nelson Mandela International Day muqarrar kiya. 18 July Mandela ki paidaish ka din hai, is liye yahi tareekh chuni gayi.
IRENA 26 January 2009 ko Bonn ki founding conference mein rasmi tor par bani. Renewable energy ke is idaray ka mustaqil headquarters Abu Dhabi hai; Bonn qayam aur Abu Dhabi daftar ka maqam hai.
Pehla rasmi BRIC leaders' summit 16 June 2009 ko Russia ke shehar Yekaterinburg mein munaqid hua.
Pehla EU-Pakistan Summit June 2009 mein Brussels mein hua. Brussels Belgium ka dar-ul-hukumat aur kai European Union idaron ka markaz hai; Belgium mezban mulk tha.
North Korea ka doosra elan-shuda nuclear test 25 May 2009 ko hua. Pehla October 2006 mein tha; 2006 pehla aur 2009 doosra tajraba dikhata hai.
Arab Spring 2010 mein Tunisia ke shehar Sidi Bouzid se shuru hui. Mohamed Bouazizi ke ehtijaji waqiay ke baad muzahire phailay aur poore khittay mein tehreekain ubhrin.
Delhi 2010 Commonwealth Games mein Pakistan ne kul paanch medals jeete, jin mein do gold thay. Dono gold wrestling mein aaye; paanch kul medals aur do sirf gold ki tadaad hai.
2 November 2011 ko Istanbul declaration se Heart of Asia-Istanbul Process apnaya gaya. Yeh Afghanistan ke aman aur istehkam ke liye ilaqai taawun ka amal tha.
2011 mein Abbottabad ki Amreeki Navy SEAL karwai ka code name Operation Neptune Spear tha. Isi operation mein Osama bin Laden mara gaya.

28 se 30 June 2011 tak 38th Council of Foreign Ministers ka ijlas Astana, Kazakhstan mein hua. Isi mein Organisation of Islamic Cooperation ka naam manzoor hua; yeh naam ki tabdeeli thi, tanzeem ki pehli bunyaad nahin.
Neil Armstrong 25 August 2012 ko 82 saal ki umr mein wafat pa gaye.

Croatia ne 2013 mein European Union ki rukniyat hasil ki aur us waqt 28wan member bana. 28wan us waqt shamil hone ki tarteeb hai; baad ki kul membership ki tadaad ko isi number ke barabar na samjhein.

2013 ke 125wein IOC ijlas mein Buenos Aires mein Tokyo ko 2020 Summer Olympics ka host chuna gaya. Waba ke sabab muqablon ka asal ineqad 2021 mein hua; selection, edition aur actual games ke saal alag hain.
2014 ka Nobel Peace Prize Malala Yousafzai aur Kailash Satyarthi ko mushtarka mila. In ki koshish bachon ke huqooq aur taleem se mutalliq thi; Satyarthi India ke children's rights karkun hain.
Hillary Clinton ki Hard Choices 2014 ki memoir hai jo un ke Secretary of State ke tajurbon par hai. Living History 2003 aur What Happened 2017 ki kitabein hain; teenon unwan alag tasaneef hain.
Pakistan ke liye EU ki GSP+ tijarati tarjeehat 1 January 2014 se nafiz huin. Is bandobast se mutalliq 27 conventions insani aur mazdoor huqooq, mahol aur achhi hukmarani se mutalliq hain.
Abdullah Abdullah ne 29 September 2014 ko national unity arrangement ke tehat Afghanistan ke Chief Executive ka halaf liya.
12 December 2015 ko COP21 mein Paris Agreement manzoor hua. Baad mein zaroori tauseeq puri hone par 4 November 2016 ko nafiz hua; adoption aur entry into force aik tareekh nahin.
2015 mein UN ne aath Millennium Development Goals ki jagah 2030 Agenda ke 17 Sustainable Development Goals apnaye. MDGs ka daur 2000 se 2015 tha, jabke SDGs naye paidar taraqqi ke hadaf thay.
Saudi Arabia ne 14 December 2015 ko Islamic Military Counter Terrorism Coalition ka elan kiya. Yeh Muslim mumalik ka dehshat-gardi ke khilaf ittehad tha.

2015 ke Amreeki federal faislay mein North America ki sab se oonchi choti ka naam Mount McKinley se Denali hua. Yeh us saal ki historical naam-tabdeeli hai, isay bila-tareekh maujooda naam ka dawa na samjhein.
AB de Villiers ne 2015 mein West Indies ke khilaf sirf 31 balls par men's ODI century banayi. Yeh 100 tak pohanchne ki balls hain, poori innings ki balls nahin.
22 April 2016 ko Paris Agreement New York ke UN Headquarters mein dastakhat ke liye khula. Paris muahiday ka naam hai, magar is ibtidai signing taqreeb ka shehar New York tha.
Paris Agreement COP21 mein 2015 mein manzoor hua aur 4 November 2016 ko nafiz hua. Nafaz zaroori tauseeq puri hone ke baad hua; is liye 2016 ko amali qanooni aghaz se jorein.
23 June 2016 ko British voters ne EU mein rehne ya nikalne par referendum mein vote diya. Valid votes mein Leave 51.9% aur Remain 48.1% tha, is liye nikalne ke haq mein mamooli aksariyat rahi.
Brexit referendum ke baad David Cameron ke isteefay par Theresa May ne 13 July 2016 ko premiership sambhali. Is tarteeb mein pehle referendum, phir Cameron ka jana aur May ki janashini hai.
Sadiq Khan ne 5 May 2016 ke London mayor election mein kamyabi hasil ki. Woh Pakistani nasab ke British siyasatdan hain.
29 July 2016 ko Afghanistan ki accession document nafiz hui aur woh WTO ka 164wan rukun bana. Number 164 us ki shamooliyat ki tarteeb hai, tanzeem ke qayam ka saal nahin.
2016 ke Kolkata men's T20 World Cup final mein West Indies ne England ko haraya. Carlos Brathwaite ne aakhri over mein lagatar chaar chhakkay lagaye aur West Indies ne doosra title liya.

2016 ki chhatti Heart of Asia-Istanbul Process ministerial conference Amritsar mein hui. Amritsar India ka shehar hai, is liye conference ke naam mein Istanbul hone ke bawajood is ijlas ka host India tha.
Emmanuel Macron ne 6 April 2016 ko En Marche siyasi tehreek banayi. Unhon ne 2017 ke sadarati election ki fatah tak is ki qayadat ki; pehle tehreek bani aur phir sadarat ka marhala aaya.
Muhammad Waseem ne 2016 mein Seoul mein Philippines ke Jether Oliva ko unanimous decision se haraya. Is se woh WBC Silver Flyweight title jeetne wale pehle Pakistani boxer bane.
Donald Trump ne 20 January 2017 ko pehli martaba halaf liya aur United States ke 45wein sadar bane. Yeh 58ween presidential inauguration taqreeb thi; sadar ka number aur taqreeb ka number alag hain.
9 June 2017 ko Astana summit mein Pakistan ko SCO ki poori rukniyat mili. Astana Kazakhstan ka dar-ul-hukumat hai, jise kuch arsa Nur-Sultan bhi kaha gaya; faisla isi summit mein hua.
18 June 2017 ko Pakistan ne India ko 180 runs se hara kar pehli ICC Champions Trophy jeeti. Pakistan ne 338 banaye aur India 158 par out hua; 180 dono scores ka farq hai.
Morocco January 2017 mein African Union mein dobara shamil hua. Woh 1984 mein peshro Organisation of African Unity se alag hua tha, is liye wapsi taqreeban 33 saal baad hui.
7 May 2017 ke faisla-kun French election mein Emmanuel Macron 39 saal ki umr mein sadar muntakhib hue. Woh December 1977 mein paida hue thay.
10 July 2017 ko Iraqi PM Haider al-Abadi ne Mosul mein ISIL par fatah ka elan kiya. Mosul shumali Iraq ka bara tareekhi shehar hai aur yeh elan ISIL ke khilaf jang ka aham mor tha.
2017 mein Myanmar ki Rakhine state mein Rohingya par fauji persecution aur tashaddud hua. Bohat se panah-gazeen sarhad paar Bangladesh gaye; Rakhine asal ilaqa aur Bangladesh panah ki manzil tha.

2017 mein Dubai ke Al Marmoum ilaqay mein oonton ki specialised veterinary care ka hospital khula. Al Marmoum ka camel-racing aur sehra ki virasat se talluq hai; Dubai shehar aur Al Marmoum us ka ilaqa hai.
2017 ka COP23 Bonn, Germany mein hua, magar conference ki sadarat Fiji ke paas thi. Fiji ke PM Frank Bainimarama COP23 President thay; host jagah aur presidency ka mulk alag hain.
2017 ka pehla Arab-Islamic-American Summit Riyadh mein hua aur Nawaz Sharif aur Donald Trump ne shirkat ki. Trump ke liye yeh un ke pehle bairuni sadarati safar ke dauran tha.
Adama Barrow ke iqtidar sambhalne ke baad Gambia ne Islamic Republic wala purana naam chhor diya. UN record mein Republic of The Gambia ki tabdeeli 16 February 2017 se moassar hai.
2017 mein African National Congress ne Cyril Ramaphosa ko party ka sadar muntakhib kiya. Woh baad mein South Africa ke mulki sadar bane; party sadarat aur riyasati sadarat alag mansab hain.
2018 FIFA World Cup ki mezbani Russia ne ki aur France champion bana. Moscow ke final mein France ne Croatia ko 4-2 se haraya; Croatia runner-up tha.
24 June 2018 se Saudi Arabia mein khawateen ko qanoonan gari chalane ki ijazat mili. Is din lambi pabandi ke baad unhon ne sarakon par driving shuru ki; yeh ijazat ke nafaz ki tareekh hai.
Saudi sahafi Jamal Khashoggi 2 October 2018 ko Istanbul ke Saudi consulate ke andar qatl hue.
Pakistan mein 25 July 2018 ko qaumi aur soobai assembly intikhabat ki mulk bhar mein polling hui.
PM banne ke baad Imran Khan ne September 2018 mein pehla international safar Saudi Arabia se shuru kiya. Isi safar mein agla mulk United Arab Emirates tha; pehli aur doosri manzil ki tarteeb yeh hai.
2018 mein Coradia iLint hydrogen fuel-cell passenger train Germany mein commercial musafir service mein aayi.
2018 mein 55 kilometre lamba Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge system khola gaya. Pul, zair-e-samandar tunnel aur masnoi jazair Pearl River Estuary ke in teen ilaqon ko milate hain.
10th BRICS Summit 25 se 27 July 2018 tak Johannesburg, South Africa mein munaqid hui.
UN Security Council ne 14 November 2018 ko Eritrea ki pabandiyan khatam ki. Yeh December 2009 se lagi thin; 2009 pabandiyon ka aghaz aur 2018 un ka ikhtitam hai.
19 June 2018 ko U.S. ne Human Rights Council chhorne ka elan kiya. Amreeki hukam ne Israel ke khilaf mubayyana janibdari aur ghair-mutanasib tawajjoh ko wajah bataya; yeh un ka bayan-karda sabab tha.
14 March 2018 ko Bundestag ne Angela Merkel ko lagatar chauthi muddat ke liye Chancellor chuna. Unhon ne isi din halaf liya; election aur fourth-term oath aik hi din hue.
April 2018 mein Miguel Diaz-Canel ne Raul Castro ke baad Cuba ki Council of State ki sadarat sambhali. Raul kuch arsa party ki qayadat mein rahe, is liye riyasati aur party mansab ko alag samjhein.

2018 general election mein ittehad ki kamyabi par Mahathir Mohamad ne doosri martaba Malaysia ki premiership sambhali. Yeh doosra daur February 2020 tak raha; 2018 un ki siyasat mein wapsi ka saal hai.
2018 mein North Korea ne ghariyan 30 minutes aage karke UTC+9 apnaya. Is ka maqsad South Korea ke standard time se milana tha, jis se dono phir aik time zone par aa gaye.

2018 Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting mein rehnumaon ne Prince Charles ko Elizabeth II ke baad Head of the Commonwealth manane par ittefaq kiya. Yeh janashheen chunne ka faisla tha; woh baad mein King Charles III bane.
WHO ki pehli Global Conference on Air Pollution and Health 30 October se 1 November 2018 tak Geneva mein hui. Is ka mauzu hawa ki aloodgi aur sehat tha.

2018 Medicine Nobel James P. Allison aur Tasuku Honjo ko cancer therapy ki daryaft par mila. Unhon ne immune system ke rokne wale checkpoints par kaam kiya, jis se cancer ke ilaj ki nayi bunyaad bani.
Jair Bolsonaro ne Brazil ka 2018 sadarati election jeeta. Unhon ne 1 January 2019 ko mansab sambhala, is liye intikhab 2018 aur halaf agle saal hua.
1 January 2019 ko Jair Bolsonaro ne Brazil ki sadarat sambhali. Is se pehle woh 2018 ka election jeet chuke thay; 2019 un ki muddat ke amali aghaz ka saal hai.
Malala Yousafzai ki We Are Displaced January 2019 mein shaya hui. Is mein be-ghar aur muhajir larkiyon ke tajurbe hain, jin mein Zaynab aur Muzoon ki kahaniyan bhi shamil hain.

December 2019 mein Wuhan mein ghair-maloom sabab ke pneumonia cases ka cluster report hua, jise baad mein naye coronavirus se jora gaya. WHO ke China Country Office ko 31 December 2019 ko is cluster ki ittila mili; yeh ittila ki tareekh hai.

TIME ne 2019 mein Greta Thunberg ko aalami climate activism mein un ke numayan kirdar par Person of the Year chuna. Woh us waqt 16 saal ki thin aur yeh ezaaz hasil karne wali sab se kam-umr shakhsiyat banin.

Volodymyr Zelenskyy siyasat se pehle actor aur comedian ke taur par mashhoor thay; woh script writing aur production bhi karte thay. Unhon ne Ukraine ka 2019 ka sadarti intikhab jeeta aur usi saal pehli baar President bane.
2019 ka Men's Cricket World Cup England aur Wales ne mil kar host kiya. Final London ke Lord's ground mein hua.
18th Non-Aligned Movement Summit 25–26 October 2019 ko Azerbaijan ke dar-ul-hukoomat Baku mein hua.
Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman 17 February 2019 ko Islamabad pohnche aur 17–18 February ka rasmi daura kiya. Agle din sarkari mulaqatein huin; 17 February aamad ki tareekh thi.
Kristalina Georgieva ne 1 October 2019 ko IMF Managing Director ka ohda sambhala. Un ki paidaish Bulgaria ke dar-ul-hukoomat Sofia mein hui.

2019 mein presidential declaration ke zariye Jammu and Kashmir se mutalliq Article 370 ki operative provisions ko inoperative kiya gaya. Is se mutalliq Indian Supreme Court ka faisla baad mein 11 December 2023 ko aaya; aaini qadam aur adalati faislay ke saal alag hain.

India ke Citizenship (Amendment) Act ko 12 December 2019 ko President ki manzoori mili. Sarkari Gazette mein iska number Act No. 47 of 2019 hai; tareekh assent ko aur 47 us ke act number ko zahir karta hai.

Aleem Dar ne December 2019 mein apna 129wan Test umpire karke Steve Bucknor ke 128 Tests ka record paar kiya. Yeh record Test matches mein officiating ki tadaad ka tha, khilari ke taur par matches khelne ka nahin.

Taiwan ne May 2019 mein same-sex marriages ke qanooni registration ki ijazat di. Is qadam se Taiwan Asia ki pehli jurisdiction bani jahan is qisam ki shadi ko qanooni tor par tasleem aur register kiya gaya.

United Kingdom 31 January 2020 ko European Union se rasmi taur par alag hua. Is se pehle 2019 mein UK samait EU ke 28 rukun thay; 28 wali ginti ko British withdrawal se pehle ke waqt ke saath jorna zaroori hai.

Luxembourg ne 29 February 2020 se mulk bhar ki aam darjay ki bus, train aur tram services fare-free kar dein. Yahan free transport se murad in nationwide regular services ka kiraya khatam hona hai; tareekh leap-year ka 29 February tha.

US-Taliban muahida 29 February 2020 ko Qatar ke dar-ul-hukoomat Doha mein hua. Is mein Afghan zameen America aur us ke allies ki salamti ke khilaf istemal na hone ki zamanat shamil thi; Doha Agreement ka naam isi shehar se nikla.
Misr ke sabiq President Hosni Mubarak 25 February 2020 ko wafat pa gaye.
UAE aur Israel ne taluqaat mamool par lane ke ittefaq ka mushtarka ailan 13 August 2020 ko kiya. Baqaida dastakhat September mein hue; ailan aur muahiday ki signing ko aik hi tareekh na samjhein.
Israel-UAE Abraham Accords Peace Agreement par 15 September 2020 ko Washington mein dastakhat hue. Is ka maqsad dono ke taluqaat mamool par lana tha; yahan tareekh formal signing ke marhalay ki hai.
Barack Obama ki A Promised Land November 2020 mein shaya hui aur un ki sadarti yaad-dashton ki pehli jild bani. Is mein un ka ibtidai siyasi safar aur sadarat ka bayan hai; yeh un ki apni memoir hai.
Douglas Stuart ne 2020 ka Booker Prize apne novel Shuggie Bain ke liye jeeta. Yeh un ka debut, yani pehla novel, tha; musannif ke safar mein pehli tasneef hi is bare adabi ezaaz tak pahunchi.

Naseem Shah ne 2020 ke Rawalpindi Test mein Bangladesh ke khilaf lagatar teen wickets le kar hat-trick ki. Woh us waqt 16 saal ke thay aur Test hat-trick karne wale sab se kam-umr bowler ka record banaya.

Kaavan hathi ko 2020 mein Pakistan se Cambodia ke aik hifazati center mein behtar falahi halaat ke liye muntaqil kiya gaya. Islamabad High Court ke hukm aur nigrani mein mehfooz muntaqili ka intizam hua.
UAE ki labour-law tarmeem 25 September 2020 se private sector mein nafiz hui. Is ne aik jaisay ya barabar qeemat ke kaam par khawateen aur mardon ko barabar ujrat dene ka usool wazeh kiya.

Joe Biden ne 20 January 2021 ko Trump ki pehli muddat ke baad 46wein American President ka halaf liya. Biden ke baad Donald Trump 20 January 2025 ko 47wein President bane; sawal mein pehli muddat ka hawala is tarteeb ko wazeh karta hai.
Kamala Harris 2021 mein ohda sambhal kar United States ki pehli khatoon Vice President banin. Un ka tareekhi ezaaz naib-sadarat se mutalliq hai.

Tokyo 2020 Summer Olympics pandemic ki wajah se aik saal multawi hokar 2021 mein hue, magar naam Tokyo 2020 hi raha. In ka rasmi naam Games of the XXXII Olympiad tha; event label ka saal aur asal munaqid hone ka saal alag hain.

IOC ne 20 July 2021 ko Olympic motto mein Together ka lafz shamil karne ki manzoori di. Naya mukammal motto Faster, Higher, Stronger – Together bana; tabdeeli purane alfaaz ko mitana nahin, un ke saath naya lafz jorna thi.

COP26 climate conference 2021 mein Scotland ke shehar Glasgow mein hui aur is ki sadarat United Kingdom ne ki. Italy ne kuch tayyariyon mein shirkat ki thi; mezban shehar Glasgow aur presidential country UK ko alag pehchanein.
Angela Merkel 2005 se December 2021 tak Germany ki Chancellor rahin, yani 16 saal. December 2021 mein Bundestag ne Olaf Scholz ko Chancellor chuna aur Merkel ka taweel daur khatam hua.
Pakistani doctor Anita Zaidi 2021 mein U.S. National Academy of Medicine mein muntakhib hui thin. Un ki citation bachon ki muta'addi bimariyon aur global health research mein qiyadat se mutalliq thi.

World Environment Day 2021 ka theme Ecosystem Restoration, yani maholiyati nizam ki bahali, tha. Pakistan ne UNEP ke saath rasmi taqreebat host ki aur isi mauqay par UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration ka aaghaz hua.

Russia ne March 2021 mein janwaron ke liye Carnivac-Cov vaccine register hone ka ailan kiya. Use SARS-CoV-2 ke khilaf janwaron ki pehli nationally approved vaccine bataya gaya; yeh insani COVID vaccination se alag product tha.

Qatar ne November–December 2022 mein FIFA World Cup host kiya. Lusail Stadium ke final mein Argentina ne France ko penalty shoot-out mein hara kar title jeeta; Argentina champion aur France runner-up raha.
China ne 2022 ke Winter Olympics Beijing mein karwaye. Isi shehar ne is se pehle 2008 ke Summer Olympics bhi host kiye thay; Beijing ke dono Games ka mausami event aur saal alag hai.

Arooj Aftab ne 2022 mein Mohabbat ki recording ke liye Best Global Music Performance ka Grammy jeeta. Is kamyabi se woh Grammy jeetne wali pehli Pakistani khatoon banin; gana, award category aur pehli-khatoon ka ezaaz isi jeet se jure hain.

FATF ne 21 October 2022 ko Pakistan ko increased monitoring se hatane ka faisla kiya. Aam zaban ki grey list ka rasmi naam Jurisdictions under increased monitoring hai; removal isi makhsoos nigrani ki fehrist se tha.
Droupadi Murmu ne 25 July 2022 ko India ki President ka halaf liya aur un ki sadarati muddat shuru hui.
Roger Federer ne 2022 mein Laver Cup ke mauqay par professional tennis se retirement li. Apne career ke aakhir tak un ke men's singles Grand Slam titles 20 thay; yeh career ka final total hai.

CODA ne 2022 ke Academy Awards mein Best Picture jeeta aur streaming platform se aane wali pehli aisi winner bani. Isi film mein walid ka kirdar ada karne wale Troy Kotsur ne Best Supporting Actor ka Oscar jeeta.
India ne 9–10 September 2023 ko New Delhi mein 18th G20 Leaders' Summit host kiya. Rasmi Leaders' Declaration bhi isi shehar ke naam se mansoob hai.

African Union ko September 2023 ke New Delhi summit mein G20 ki permanent membership mili. Is izafay ke baad G20 ke structure mein 19 mulkon ke saath do regional bodies, European Union aur African Union, shamil huin.

Ajay Banga ne 2 June 2023 ko World Bank Group President ki paanch-saala muddat shuru ki. 2 February 2026 un ke is haisiyat mein Pakistan ke pehle rasmi dauray ki tareekh thi; office ka aaghaz aur daura alag waqiat hain.

Australia aur New Zealand ne 2023 ka FIFA Women's World Cup mil kar host kiya. Spain ne final mein England ko 1–0 se hara kar championship jeeti; mezban do mulk thay, jabke finalists Spain aur England thay.
July 2023 ki heatwave ko Cerberus ka laqab diya gaya. Is ne khas taur par Southern Europe aur Mediterranean ilaqon mein shadeed aur taweel garmi paida ki.

Indian Supreme Court ne In Re: Article 370 ka faisla 11 December 2023 ko sunaya. Is ka pas-e-manzar 2019 mein Jammu and Kashmir se mutalliq operative provisions ko inoperative karne wale aaini iqdamaat thay; dono saal alag marhalon ke hain.
Sweden ne accession document jama karwa kar 7 March 2024 ko NATO ki mukammal membership hasil ki. Woh NATO ka 32wan rukun bana; Finland ke baad Sweden ke izafay se us waqt tadaad 32 hui.

France ne 2024 ke Summer Olympics host kiye aur Paris markazi mezban shehar tha. Opening ceremony riwayati stadium ke bajaye bunyadi taur par Seine River ke raste hui; darya ceremony ki khaas pehchan tha.

Arshad Nadeem ne Paris 2024 ke men's javelin final mein 92.97 metre throw karke Pakistan ke liye gold jeeta. Yeh final ki un ki doosri koshish thi aur naya Olympic record bana; distance aur medal isi throw se jure hain.
South Sudan January 2024 ke Kampala summit mein Non-Aligned Movement ka 121wan rukun bana. Us ki shamooliyat se membership 121 riyasaton tak pahunchi; yeh us summit ke baad ka total hai.

India ne 1 July 2024 ko teen naye national criminal codes nafiz kiye, jo colonial daur ke aham codes ki jagah aaye. Un mein Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ne Indian Penal Code ki jagah li; yeh bunyadi substantive criminal code ki tabdeeli thi.
Donald Trump par 13 July 2024 ko campaign rally ke dauran qatilana hamla hua. Rally Butler mein thi, jo Pennsylvania state ka shehar hai.
SCO Heads of State ka 24wan summit 4 July 2024 ko Kazakhstan ke shehar Astana mein hua. Isi ijlas mein Astana Declaration apnayi gayi; summit ka shehar aur ailan ka naam aapas mein jure hain.

Donald Trump ne Joe Biden ke baad 20 January 2025 ko 47wein American President ka halaf liya. Is se pehle Trump ki pehli muddat ke baad Biden 20 January 2021 ko 46wein President bane thay; yeh do alag transitions hain.

Paris Saint-Germain ne 31 May 2025 ko Munich ke final mein Inter ko 5–0 se hara kar pehli UEFA Champions League jeeti. Season ka naam 2024–25 hai, jabke final 2025 mein hua; champion PSG aur runner-up Inter tha.

Pakistan aur Saudi Arabia ne 17 September 2025 ko Riyadh mein Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement kiya. Is mein kisi aik mulk ke khilaf jarhiyat ko dono ke khilaf jarhiyat samajhne ka usool shamil tha.
2025 ka SCO Heads of State Summit China ke shehar Tianjin mein 31 August se 1 September tak hua. Yeh do-roza summit August ke aakhri aur September ke pehle din par phaila tha.

COP30 UN climate conference 2025 mein Brazil ke shehar Belem mein hui; rasmi conference dates 10–21 November thin. Belem Amazon khittay ka aham darwaza hai; yahan dates rasmi schedule ko zahir karti hain.
Hungary ke novelist Laszlo Krasznahorkai ko 2025 ka Nobel Prize in Literature diya gaya; yeh un ki adabi khidmat ka aalami ezaaz tha.

Dr Muhammad Amjad Saqib ko Brain Trust ka Brain of the Year 2025 award diya gaya. Woh Akhuwat ke bani hain, jo Pakistan mein bila-sood maali madad deti hai; ezaaz aur falahi idaray ki pehchan aik hi shakhs se juri hain.

Israel ne 13 June 2025 ko Iran ke khilaf Operation Rising Lion shuru kiya. Israeli bayanaat ke mutabiq targets Iran ke nuclear programme aur fauj se mutalliq thay; target categories ko unhi bayanaat ki nisbat se samjhein.
PIMEC 2025, 3–6 November ko Karachi Expo Centre mein hui. Is ne Pakistan ki maritime salahiyat, difaai technology aur samundari shobay ki innovation ko numayan kiya.
Italy ne Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics 2026 ki mezbani ki. In sarmayi Games ka aghaz 6 February 2026 ko hua.
